html: Yazne is the name the map gives to a small people of the foothills of southern Ecuador, in today's El Oro province, near the border with Peru. Very little is recorded about them. They were one of many small groups in the hills behind the Gulf of Guayaquil, between the Cañari to the north and the Paltas and Malacatos to the south and east. The Inca brought this area under their rule in the late 1400s, and after the Spanish conquest its small peoples vanish from the records as separate groups.
